original_value: The diversity of substantive expertise and analytical techniques encompassed by learning analytics can be a challenge for understanding and interrogating methodological choices. But active pursuit of methodological clarity is essential to productive multi-vocality. This was the focus of the LAK ’17 Methodology in Learning Analytics workshop from which the idea for this special section arose. Discussions were framed using a building metaphor of developing structurally sound bridges between disciplinary methods. Strong arguments are buttressed by supporting evidence and warrants but also engage with potential alternative explanations. Papers in this special section further the discussion and span a range of relevant approaches including sensitivity analysis, model evaluation and model fit, causal inference, and visualisation as a methodology. All advance the case of structural integrity in this bridge discipline and highlight the importance of adequate descriptions of methodological considerations to aid our interrogation of methodology and epistemology.

result.paraphrase: The wide range of substantive expertise and analytical techniques in learning analytics can make it difficult to understand and scrutinize methodological choices. Yet actively pursuing methodological clarity is vital for productive multi-vocality. That was the aim of the LAK ’17 Methodology in Learning Analytics workshop, which inspired this special section. The discussions were organized around a building metaphor: creating structurally sound bridges between disciplinary methods. Robust arguments are supported by evidence and warrants, while also addressing possible alternative explanations. The papers in this special section extend the conversation and cover several relevant approaches, including sensitivity analysis, model evaluation and fit, causal inference, and visualisation as a methodology. Together, they strengthen the case for structural integrity in this bridge discipline and underscore the need for thorough descriptions of methodological considerations to support our interrogation of methodology and epistemology.
